{{Quote|It's as if you staged a recreation of the Siege of Ramsir with the Imperial Army limited to parade sabers.|Hu Jibwe|<ref name="Blog" />}}
A '''parade saber''',<ref name="Blog" /> also known as a '''ceremonial officer's saber''', was a type of [[Sword/Legends|sword]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were worn by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]<ref name="THG" /> for ceremonial purposes, and were not meant to be used for [[Ground warfare/Legends|warfare]].<ref name="Blog" /> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a former Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], once dreamed that he was publicly read out of the military as a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]]. The ceremony involved another officer snapping the ceremonial saber&mdash;the blade of which had been weakened by a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] score in advance&mdash;over their knee.<ref name="THG" />
